#### Shiprocket Username

* The Shiprocket Username is the unique identifier used to access your Shiprocket account and integrate its API with your system.

#### Shiprocket Password

* The Shiprocket Password is a secure key used to authenticate your access to the Shiprocket API.

#### Shiprocket Channel Id

* The Shiprocket Channel Id is a unique identifier assigned to your specific shipping channel, used to route and track your orders.

#### Shiprocket Webhook Token

* The Webhook Token is a security token used to verify that webhook notifications received from Shiprocket are authentic and have not been tampered with.
* This is the<html style="color : red">most recommended</html>to setup webhook
* Please read<html style="color : red">'To Setup Webhook'</html>which is given below for setup webhook.

***

#### To Generate Shiprocket Username and Shiprocket Password

* **Visit the Shiprocket Website:**
  * Open your web browser and navigate to [Shiprocket](https://www.shiprocket.in/)
  * Click on the "Sign Up" or "Register" button if you are new to Shiprocket.
* **Register for a Shiprocket Account:**
  * Fill in the required registration details, such as your business name, email, contact number, and any other requested information.
  * Submit the registration form and verify your email (if required) to activate your account.
* **Log In to Your Account:**
  * Once your account is activated, log in using the email and password you created during registration.
* **Access Your Dashboard:**
  * After logging in, you will be directed to your Shiprocket dashboard. This is where you can manage your account and access integration    details.
* **Locate Your Shiprocket Username:**
  * In the dashboard, navigate to the “Settings” or “Developer Settings” section.
  * Within Settings, find and click on “API Users” or a similar option related to API credentials.
  * Click on the “Add New API User” button or update existing users credentials.
* **Retrieve or Set Your Password:**
  * The password you created during registration is your Shiprocket Password.
  * If you need to change or generate a new password, look for an option like “Change Password” or “Reset Password” in the settings.
  * Follow the prompts to update your password as needed.
* **Copy and Save Your Keys:**
  * Once you have your Shiprocket Username and confirmed your password, ensure you store these details in a secure location (e.g., a password manager).
  * Now copy the keys And paste it here in the **Shiprocket Username** and **Shiprocket Password Key** column.
* **Use Your credentials Safely:**
  * Do not share your credentials with anyone.

***

#### To Generate Shiprocket Channel Id

* **Log In to Your Shiprocket Account**
  * Open your web browser and navigate to[Shiprocket](https://www.shiprocket.in/)
  * Log in using your Shiprocket credentials.
* **Navigate to the Integration or Channel Settings Section**
  * Once logged in, access your dashboard.
  * Look for sections labeled **"Setup & Manage"** or **"Channel Management"**. These sections typically house the details related to your shipping channels.
* **Locate the Channel Management Area**
  * In the **Setup & Manage** menu, find the option to **"Channels"** or **"Manage Shipping Channels".**
  * If your dashboard lists existing channels, check if a **Channel Id** is already assigned to your account or if there’s an option to generate a new one.
* **Generate a New Channel Id (If Required)**
  * If you need to create a new shipping channel, look for a button or link such as **"Add New Channel"** or **"Generate Channel Id"**.
  * Click on this option and follow any on-screen instructions to enter necessary details (for example, selecting a service type or providing additional shipping information).
* **Retrieve and Record Your Channel Id**
  * Once generated, the system will display your new Channel Id.
  * Copy this Channel Id immediately and pate it here in **Shiprocket Channel Id** column.

#### To Setup Shiprocket Webhook

* **Log In to Your Shiprocket Account**
  * Open your web browser and navigate to [Shiprocket](https://www.shiprocket.in/).
  * Log in using your Shiprocket credentials.
* **Access the Webhook Settings**
  * From your dashboard, locate the **Settings** or **Integration/API Settings** section.
  * Look for the **Webhook Configuration** option within this area. If you can’t find it immediately, check under sections like “Developer Settings” or “Notifications.”
* **Enter Your Webhook URL**
  * In the Webhook Configuration page, enter the URL of your server endpoint where you wish to receive webhook notifications.
  * The **Webhook URL** should be:<html style="color : red">https://{yourdomainName}/api/public/webhook/ship_rocket/shipment</html>
  * eg: 
       [https://example.com/api/public/webhook/ship_rocket/shipment](https://example.com/api/public/webhook/ship_rocket/shipment)
* **Select Event Types (If Available)**
  * Some setups allow you to choose which events trigger a webhook notification (e.g., order pickup, shipment dispatched, delivery status updates).
  * Select the events that are relevant to your business needs.
* **Set a Webhook Secret Key**
  * Enter the necessary <html style="color : red">Security Token</html>to help verify the authenticity of incoming webhook payloads.
  * Insert this same Secret Key here also **Shiprocket Webhook Token** column.
  * Make sure you store this secret securely.
* **Save Your Webhook Configuration**
  * Click **Test** or **Save** to apply your webhook settings.
  * Confirm that the configuration has been saved successfully.
